description.en: Over 50 ready-to-use high-converting website templates and UI components.
description.zh: 涵盖 50 多款高转化率营销模板与常用 React + Tailwind 交互组件。

content.en: Easy UI is a rapid development component and template ecosystem built with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Designed to help developers launch polished SaaS landing pages in minutes, Easy UI offers high-converting section blocks and interactive widgets.
content.zh: Easy UI 是一套专注于提升交付速度与商业转化率的 React + Tailwind CSS 模板与组件系统。收录超 50 款经过转化率优化的落地页模版与精修交互组件，帮助独立开发者与创业团队在极短时间内上线具备专业视觉的商业站点。
